headline: Hyperia City launches: first Set 14 weekend has Amber/Emerald, Amber/Amethyst and Emerald/Steel winning, plus two big CCQs

tldr.text: Hyperia City (Set 14: 242 cards, Coco and the new Ink Drop mechanic) went on general sale Oct. 23, a week after the Oct. 16 prereleases.

The first Set 14 Core weekend had different winners in different places. Amber/Amethyst won Heroes Ink in Germany, Amber/Emerald Songs won Top Deck Keep in the US, and Steel/Emerald Evasive won Quest Coast IV.

Two Core Constructed Qualifiers that award NAC invites ran on Oct. 24. BlingGuest won the 144-player Lorca-Breizh CCQ in France, and Darian won the 79-player Through the Decades Infinity 5K in the US.

Ravensburger revealed Collector Boosters and a new Illustrious rarity. Both arrive with Into the Inkdark on Feb. 12, 2027, and will only be sold at Ravensburger Play Hub stores, Ravensburger's online store and select Disney locations.

The Quest World Iconic Clash, a 16-player invitational where the prize is an iconic Hades – Looking for a Deal, published all 16 decklists and is releasing Round 1 matches. Amber/Emerald Songs and Emerald/Amethyst Retro are the most common decks.

meta.text: The Quest World Iconic Clash decklists are the first look at Set 14 decks from top players. Three players brought Amber/Emerald Songs (Bryan Pereira, Jacob Frank, Joseph Quigley) and two brought Emerald/Amethyst Retro (Alessandro Cavalli, Fungus). There was also an Amber/Steel Rockstar Stitch deck from vVonderland and an Emerald/Sapphire brew from Lukas Kaupa.

Emerald/Steel still has its spot. Frank Karsten and Shane Downey played an Emerald/Steel mirror in QWIC Round 1, and a 6-1-1 Steel/Emerald Evasive list won Quest Coast IV (27 players). A budget Sapphire/Amber Detectives deck (about $52) also made top 8 there.
At Heroes Ink (36 players, DE), Amber/Amethyst took 1st and another copy made top 4. Amber/Emerald Aggro was 2nd and an Emerald/Steel deck made top 4.
At Top Deck Keep (31 players, US), Amber/Emerald Songs won and put another copy in top 4. Amber/Ruby was 2nd and Amber/Amethyst made top 4.
At Il Laboratorio Giochi's Hyperia City Core event in Italy (30 players), Amber/Emerald Circle took three of the five listed spots and Amber/Amethyst Merida took the other two.

For comparison, inkdecks' October Core Constructed report had Emerald/Steel Evasive on top at about 23%, ahead of Amber/Emerald Circle at about 15%, with Amber/Sapphire Princesses also in the top tier.

Some cards and decks are getting noticed early. Manifest calls Flash a new Steel staple and called Max Goof one of the most powerful cards in the game. Podcana asked whether Ruby/Emerald is real after building 15 Set 14 decks, and The Lore College says Amber/Ruby got an upgrade.

players.text: BlingGuest won the biggest event of the week, the 144-player Grand Tournoi CCQ Lorca-Breizh in France, with a list titled 'Canarder la Bretagne'.
Darian won the 79-player Through the Decades CCQ Infinity 5K in the US with 'Cortisol Down, Paws Up'.
TT_Egelim won Heroes Ink (36 players) on Amber/Amethyst. Kaiiku won Top Deck Keep (31 players) on Amber/Emerald Songs. [FT20] JP won Quest Coast IV (27 players) on Steel/Emerald Evasive.
Other winners: LBT_Elros won the 50-player Al Ritmo de la Magia in Spain, and GabryCu1o won the 30-player Win 2 Cases event in Italy. Neither win came with ink colors.

news.text: Into the Inkdark (Feb. 12, 2027) will add Collector Boosters and a new Illustrious rarity, which Lorcana co-founder Ryan Miller explained in an IGN interview. A new Inkdark card was also revealed on Instagram this week.
The D23 2026 boxes and the foil Pooh playmat are being released again through an EQL raffle. Official online sales run from Oct. 31 at 9am ET to Nov. 1 at 9pm ET.
The Cauldron Cup CCQ survey closes Oct. 30, and DLC Tampa tickets are on sale.
Pixelborn Connect now runs in the browser. It supports ranked webcam games and has an option to hide your hand from your opponent, so streamers can show it to viewers.

community.text: People are already calling Flash overtuned: a 2-cost card with Resist 1 that quests for 2 and punishes Rush decks. The Rules of Villainy podcast named its new episode 'Flash Mob at the Smithy'.
A Reddit thread complains that Raging Storm feels oppressive online, with players getting hit two or three times a game now that Set 14 adds more discard and draw.

Hyperia City is easy to find at or below MSRP, unlike Vine and Wilds. At least one game store held stock back for its regulars, and one player complained about identical common-slot sequences across boxes.

Videos worth watching: Xenulous joined JBaum's Alter Academy to cover Emerald/Amethyst Retro, the ICL Season 4 Round 6 'Infinity Week' matches are up, and Lorcana Villain broke down the QWIC decklists and the top 8s from Heroes Ink and Top Deck Keep.
